import csv, os, shutil
from decimal import Decimal

D = "/app/documents"
INV = "/app/invoices"
OTH = "/app/other"

# filename -> (class, total_amount, vat_amount)
data = {
    "2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg": ("invoice", "6558.00", "0.00"),   # Total 6558 vs Amount due 4382 -> use Total
    "6NVuAIhTV4KB.jpg": ("other", None, None),
    "F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg": ("other", None, None),
    "JOiylq2_7S18.jpg": ("invoice", "6860.45", "623.68"),
    "KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg": ("invoice", "9963.00", "0.00"),   # Total 9963 vs Amount due 7139 -> use Total
    "QOoA_j33PD_E.jpg": ("other", None, None),
    "WqWMArQQlSMv.jpg": ("other", None, None),
    "ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg": ("invoice", "819.06", "74.46"),
    "lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg": ("invoice", "797.91", "72.54"),
    "vvK89XK847m3.jpg": ("invoice", "6204.19", "564.02"),
    "w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg": ("invoice", "44745.59", "4067.78"),
    "GFAlpKoFg81H.pdf": ("other", None, None),
    "T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf": ("invoice", "4031.00", "0.00"),
    "UsN9tVTKskms.pdf": ("invoice", "896.00", "0.00"),
    "dvkRkFVFhHga.pdf": ("other", None, None),
    "dx0AWchV01ZJ.pdf": ("other", None, None),
    "wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf": ("invoice", "440.00", "0.00"),
}

files = sorted(os.listdir(D))
assert set(files) == set(data.keys()), (set(files) ^ set(data.keys()))

rows = []
for f in sorted(data):
    cls, total, vat = data[f]
    src = os.path.join(D, f)
    if cls == "invoice":
        shutil.move(src, os.path.join(INV, f))
        rows.append([f, total, vat])
    else:
        shutil.move(src, os.path.join(OTH, f))

with open(os.path.join(INV, "summary.csv"), "w", newline="") as fh:
    w = csv.writer(fh)
    w.writerow(["filename", "total_amount", "vat_amount"])
    for r in sorted(rows):
        w.writerow(r)
    tot = sum(Decimal(r[1]) for r in rows)
    vtot = sum(Decimal(r[2]) for r in rows)
    w.writerow(["total", f"{tot:.2f}", f"{vtot:.2f}"])

print("invoices:", len(rows), "other:", len(files)-len(rows))
print("TOTAL", f"{tot:.2f}", "VAT", f"{vtot:.2f}")
EOF
python3 /tmp/process.py
